comparison.objective: Align a loose splash-shield panel and fasten it with a push-in clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hole alignment followed by axial insertion through two layers and a sprung catch.
comparison.success_condition: Panel holes aligned and clip fully home, stable for one second.
comparison.reason: This is hold-and-fasten insertion through aligned holes; the candidate instead requires continuous rail support during longitudinal carriage transfer and prevention of rolling-element loss.
